name: AccessTokenForm
summary: Connects this reference workflow using a caller-supplied bearer token or optional local synthetic identity.
usage: Keep credential handling inside this feature. Reuse Button and TextField for shared presentation; this form is not a general login, session or refresh component.
accessibility: Provides a labeled required password field and a native submit action. Errors remain visible; connections and synthetic identity requests require explicit user actions.

props.name: onConnect
props.meaning: Receives a token in memory after an explicit connection; never persist or log it.

props.name: showLocalIdentity
props.meaning: Shows optional synthetic development identities when available.

examples.label: Feature-owned connection form
examples.description: Source example only; the catalog never connects credentials or calls an identity service.
